Title: Improvements to personalization in the Azure preview portal

Body.Content:
The following list itemizes improvements to personalization in the Azure preview portal:
  • Personalized Service health experience (focus on your services)
  • Rename, move, delete, and add groups in resource blades (such as websites and virtual machines)
  • A Part Gallery that provides access to parts that can enrich your resource blades
For more information, see:
  • Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (April Update)
  • Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (January 2015)
